Proceeding Sheet Sl. Office No. Date Order

entities.text: High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NOTE 04. 06.04.2026 BVLNC,J I.A.No.02 of 2024 Not pressed.

BVLNC,J I.A.No.03 of 2024 Heard Sri P.Kiran Hemanth, learned counsel representing Sri Rosedar S.R.A., learned Leal Aid Counsel for the petitioner/appellant/convict and Sri C.Panini Somayaji, learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the State.

The petitioner is sole accused in SC ST SC No.2 of 2016 on the file of the learned Special Judge for Trial of Cases under SCs & STs (PoA) Act - cum - X Additional District & Sessions Judge, East Godavari at Rajamahendravaram.

entities.text: SCs & STs (PoA) Act - cum - X Additional
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner/convict was found guilty for the offence punishable under Section 376 (1) IPC and accordingly he was convicted and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only), in default to undergo simple Contd., imprisonment for a period of six (06)
months.
The learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant would submit that the learned trial Court erroneously convicted the petitioner without appreciating the facts in proper perspective.
Hence, the petitioner preferred the appeal, challenging the judgment on various grounds and there is a fair chance to succeed in the appeal.
The appellant is in prison for the last 7 years and 4 months.
Therefore, he served  of the sentence out of fixed sentence of ten (10) years and there is no possibility of hearing the appeal in the near future.
Therefore, the order of sentence of imprisonment imposed by the trial Court may be suspended, pending disposal of the appeal.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the present application.
However, no written objections filed by the prosecution.
It is an admitted fact that the appellant served 7 years and 4 months of sentence out of fixed sentence of ten (10) years of sentence imposed by the trial Court.

Therefore, considering the above circumstances of the case and there is no possibility of taking the appeal for hearing in the near future "the order of sentence of imprisonment alone imposed by the Contd., learned Special Judge for Trial of Cases under SCs & STs (PoA) Act - cum - X Additional District & Sessions Judge, East Godavari at Rajamahendravaram, vide judgment dated 24.11.2022 passed in SC ST SC.No.2 of 2016 be suspended, pending disposal of the appeal and the appellant shall be released on bail subject to the following conditions:
i) The petitioner/appellant shall execute a personal bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two (02) sureties for a like sum each, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.

sentences.text: ii) The petitioner/appellant shall pay the fine amount within four (04) weeks from the date of this order before the learned trial Court, if not paid, and file receipt before this Court.
iii) On such release, the
petitioner
/ appellant shall appear before the learned trial Court, on every fourth Saturday of the month, till disposal of the Appeal.
iv) The petitioner/appellant shall not intimidate or contact or annoy the victim or her family members in any manner.

Contd..
v) The petitioner/appellant shall not involve in similar offence or any other offence in future in any manner.
vi) The petitioner/appellant shall not leave the country without permission of the Court.
vii) If the petitioner/appellant violates any of the above conditions, the prosecution is at liberty to file an application seeking cancellation of the bail.
Accordingly, this application is ordered.
BVLNC,J Heard.
Admit.
Call for Trial Court record.
Registry is directed to prepare paper booklet, as soon as trial Court record is received.
List the matter in the month of June 2026, in usual course.
